optionalfeature.name: Agonizing Lethargy
entries: You can use an action to expend a superiority die. When you do so, choose a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The target must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the target takes 1d6 necrotic damage for each attack it makes until the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Assess the Situation
entries: You can expend one superiority die to make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) or Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) check as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, adding the superiority die to the check.

optionalfeature.name: Befogging Ichor
entries: You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to expend a superiority die. When you do so, choose a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The target must make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the target can't take reactions until the start of its next turn and on its turn must use its movement to move half its {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} in a random direction. Roll a {@dice d8} and assign a direction to each face. If the direction rolled is blocked, the target doesn't move.

optionalfeature.name: Chains of Transfixing
entries: You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to expend a superiority die. When you do so, choose a creature you can see within 30 feet of you that is no more than one size larger than you. The target must succeed on a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or gain four {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} levels until the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Daring Escape
entries: You can expend one superiority die to take the {@action Disengage|sw5e-phb} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on your turn. Until the end of this turn, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} to break effects that would grapple, restrain or slow you.

optionalfeature.name: Dark Transference
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can expend a superiority die and roll it to attempt to {@spell Siphon Life|sw5e-phb|siphon life} from it. The target must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, add the result to the damage roll, and you regain one expended Hit Die.

optionalfeature.name: Deathseek
entries: When an attack made against a hostile creature that you can see would miss, you can use a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a superiority die and roll it to force the creature to instead take the hit. The creature must make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the target takes the minimum damage the attack could have dealt plus additional damage equal to the result of the superiority die.

optionalfeature.name: Deliberate Movement
entries: You can expend one superiority die to take the {@action Dash|sw5e-phb} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and ignore the effects of unenhanced {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain} until the end of your turn.

optionalfeature.name: Go Get 'Em
entries: While your companion is moving, you can expend a superiority die and add 5 times the number rolled to its movement {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}.

optionalfeature.name: Loyal Bond
entries: Whenever you are hit with an attack, you can expend one superiority die to command your companion to immediately use its {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and move up to its {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} directly towards you. If it ends this movement within 5 feet of you, roll the superiority die. Your companion takes the damage instead of you, subtracting the amount you rolled from the total.

optionalfeature.name: Pin Down
entries: When your companion attempts to grapple or knock a creature prone, you can expend a superiority die to give it direction as long as it can see or hear you. Roll a superiority die and add it to your companion's Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) check.

optionalfeature.name: Primal Endurance
entries: As an action, you can expend a superiority die to improve your companion's defense. Roll the die and add it to your companion's AC until the beginning of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Reverse Curse
entries: When another creature attempts to charm or frighten you or an ally you can see within 15 feet of you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a superiority die and roll it to attempt to turn the effect back on that creature. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or be be {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} or {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened} by you, dependent on the triggering ability, for a number of rounds equal to the die roll or until the creature takes any damage.

optionalfeature.name: Shadow Puppetry
entries: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a superiority die to give that creature a final act of aggression. That creature can immediately move a number of feet equal to 5 times the result of the die and make a single {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} against a target of your choice within its attack range, adding the die to the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}.

optionalfeature.name: Sic 'Em
entries: As an action, you can expend a superiority die and command your companion to savage a nearby enemy. Your companion can use its {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to immediately move up to 10 feet and make one attack, adding the {@book superiority dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} to the damage roll on a hit.

optionalfeature.name: Spine-Chilling Howls
entries: As an action, you can expend one superiority die to command your companion to frighten another creature. The target must then succeed on a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} save DC or become {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened} of both you and your companion for 1 minute. The {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened} target can repeat the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

optionalfeature.name: Water of Life
entries: When an allied creature within 30 feet that you can see takes damage, you can use a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to expend a superiority die and roll it. The ally regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the roll + your {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} modifier.

optionalfeature.name: Wild Senses
entries: Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) or a Wisdom ({@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}) check, you can request the aid of your companion by expending a superiority die, adding the number rolled to the check. You can use this {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} before or after making the {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, but before the results of the {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} are determined.

optionalfeature.name: Wracking Torment
entries: When a hostile creature you can see within 30 feet would take damage from an effect you or a friendly creature controls, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a superiority die to temporarily weaken their resilience against it. Until the end of the turn, the target loses {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to the damage types of the triggering attack or power.
